# help removesharesetting
removesharesetting - Remove a sharesetting.

SYNTAX
    removesharesetting <sharesetting_name>

DESCRIPTION
    The removesharesetting command removes the share setting from the system.

AUTHORITY
    Super, Edit
    Any role granted the sharesetting_remove right

OPTIONS
    -f
        Specifies that the command is forced. If this option is not used, the
        command requires confirmation before proceeding with its operation.

SPECIFIERS
    <sharesetting_name>
        Specifies a share setting name to be removed.

NOTES
    Issuing the removesharesetting command with invalid share setting name causes the
    command to fail.

    Issuing the removesharesetting command if there is any file share object associated
    with this setting causes the command to fail without removing that share setting.

EXAMPLES
    The following example removes sharesetting setting_demo

       cli% removesharesetting setting_demo
